name: Ai Wen
aliases: Ai Wen of the Sahn Ni family
description: A Temur wanderer and elder of the Sahn Ni family who bested Asham in a sparring bout and defeats him again when he challenges her.

description_citations.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Jeskai: The Unknown Way
description_citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Jeskai: The Unknown Way" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Asham relives his humiliating defeat by a Temur fighter, ended in a single strike.
timeline.quote: The fight, all over in a single strike!

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Jeskai: The Unknown Way
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Jeskai: The Unknown Way" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Ai Wen, leaving the mountain happily, eats persimmons and is halted by a monk demanding a rematch.
timeline.quote: I am Asham of the Cori Mountain Monastery. And I have tracked you down to demand a rematch.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Jeskai: The Unknown Way
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Jeskai: The Unknown Way" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Ai Wen refuses the rematch, saying their earlier bout was not a match, and throws Asham off the path into bushes.
timeline.quote: sent Asham sprawling down the cliffside.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Jeskai: The Unknown Way
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Jeskai: The Unknown Way" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Asham conjures dragonfire for the first time and attacks Ai Wen.
timeline.quote: Asham standing, hands ablaze and held out in a talon pose.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Jeskai: The Unknown Way
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Jeskai: The Unknown Way" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Ai Wen defeats Asham, breaking his ribs, and says their first bout was no fair match between an elder and a disciple.
timeline.quote: a fight between an elder and a disciple is no fair match.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Jeskai: The Unknown Way
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Jeskai: The Unknown Way" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Ai Wen praises Asham's pride and breakthrough, and Asham passes out as Ru approaches.
timeline.quote: I leave you in good hands.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Jeskai: The Unknown Way
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Jeskai: The Unknown Way" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Mar 2025.
